ui_name_correction.0x1d: 学歴; earlier reports used inferred name指導力 for this same byte. Manager academic value really is used in growth/advice rolls.
ui_name_correction.0x20: 接客; this current skill is also used in replenishment target threshold.
ui_name_correction.0x1a: 教育, also the hard limit for current cashier/security growth.

candidates: Scan35 records, eligible only if u16 owner_flags==0. Choose up to10 with rejection sampling over the original free-list length; used entries become-1 and repeated draws consume RNG.
required_manager: Staffing commit refuses an empty first slot. Transfer final validation checks first slots; native writes are not a generic transactional rollback.
hiring_commit: New assignment sets owner flags, role/sex body appearance, state0 and coordinates-1 before native rest placement; increments experience counter+20. Original unassigned look is not the hired role sprite.

growth.manager_input: academic background+0x1d of store slot0 employee
growth.rare: Draw rand()%16 once at function entry. Zero permits crossing soft limits for this call, but never the hard limit.
growth.per_attribute: Always draw roll before comparing current<hard and(current<soft or rare); increment by1 if roll1..100<=manager academic value and both bounds permit.
growth.minus1: Reduce cashier30,restocking31,cleaning33,security34 by1 only when>=2; customer_service32 is not reduced by this mode.

energy.active: If energy>0, one rand()&3==0 decrements it. Exhaustion clears non-rest-travel goals and sets flag0x1000; rest-travel state3 can keep its goal.
energy.resume: Once full, resting slot is eligible to choose work only when (clock//2)%3==slot. These are update rules, not measured seconds.

annual.gate: Finance close at stage1/month1 and minute0/hour0
annual.age: All35 records age by1 if signed age<127, including unassigned records. Age>=80 rolls rand()%5==0 for basic-trait boost; age127 guarantees it.
annual.boost: Set maximum energy24,education26,agility27,sociability28,academic29 to100. Does not directly set current energy or five current work skills to100.
annual.wage: Per active store assigned staff: wage=trunc((store+12dc+100)*wage/100). Free records outside assignments do not receive that per-store multiplication.

wage_display: Transfer profile displays wage_base*scheduled_hours; actual payroll separately applies130% to slot0 before hours. Do not conflate UI amount with charged manager amount.
